plant.description: A water reservoir. Input u in [0,1] is pump duty and raises the level; the reservoir drains on its own. Output y in [0,1] is a noisy level reading.

objective.notes: Maximize time in band and minimize tracking error; lower actuation energy is better at equal tracking.

experiments.uncertainty_targeted: Static gain magnitude and response lag: first discriminating mid-level hold separates zero-gain/dead-zone from positive-gain and gives initial rate and curvature needed to size later holds and controller gain.
experiments.expected_observation: If positive-gain with drain is right, y rises monotonically from ~0.21 toward a higher quasi-equilibrium, with positive but flattening slope in last seconds and only small noise wiggles, not falling or staying flat.

experiments.uncertainty_targeted: Static gain magnitude and steady-state u needed for y=0.6 and linearity across levels: u=0.3 settled near ~0.10, so a second higher amplitude separates weak-gain vs dead-zone vs nonlinear and sizes feedforward for control.
experiments.expected_observation: If positive-gain-with-drain is right, y should reverse from decay to a monotonic rise from ~0.09 with positive slope, gradually flattening but still positive in last seconds, reaching ~0.15-0.30 with only +/-0.01 noise and no fall or oscillation.

experiments.uncertainty_targeted: Zero-input drain behavior and decay time constant: first u=0 hold separates sustained-level vs natural-drain hypotheses and gives tau needed to infer equilibria and size controller.
experiments.expected_observation: If drain-with-positive-gain is right, y will decay monotonically from ~0.34 toward <0.15 with gradually flattening negative slope (still slightly negative in last 5 s) and only +/-0.01 noise, not rise or hold flat.

experiments.uncertainty_targeted: Static-gain nonlinearity and steady-state u needed for y=0.6: a settled intermediate amplitude discriminates linear vs superlinear extrapolation from 0.3 and 0.7 and is needed to set feedforward for control.
experiments.expected_observation: If positive-gain-with-drain and ~9s tau is right, y will rise monotonically from ~0.0 toward ~0.25-0.30, with positive but flattening slope in last 5s and only +/-0.01 noise, ending ~0.20-0.30 and still rising slightly, not flat at zero or falling.

experiments.uncertainty_targeted: High-side static gain and u needed for y=0.6 and linearity: a higher-amplitude hold from higher baseline separates linear vs saturating vs superlinear extrapolation from u=0.3/0.5/0.7 and sizes feedforward.
experiments.expected_observation: If positive-gain-with-drain and ~7-10s tau is right, y will rise monotonically from ~0.22 to ~0.33-0.40 with positive slope ~0.015-0.025/s still positive in last seconds and only +/-0.01 noise, not flat or falling.

experiments.uncertainty_targeted: High-side static gain and settling toward 0.6: continuing same 0.7 command separates linear vs superlinear extrapolation and tests whether 0.7 equilibrates near target, which directly sizes feedforward.
experiments.expected_observation: If positive-gain-with-drain and ~8-10s tau is right, y will rise monotonically from ~0.40 toward ~0.50-0.54 over 6 s with positive slope ~0.02/s still positive in last seconds and only +/-0.01 noise, not flat or falling.

experiments.uncertainty_targeted: High-side static gain and steady-state u needed for y=0.6 and near-target linearity: a 0.65 hold from 0.51 separates ss inside-band vs above-band and refines feedforward for control.
experiments.expected_observation: If tau ~8-11s and ss(0.65) ~0.55-0.65 is right, y will rise monotonically from ~0.51 to ~0.55-0.58 over 5s with positive slope ~0.015-0.02 still positive in last seconds and only +/-0.01 noise, not flat or falling.

experiments.uncertainty_targeted: High-side static gain and settling at operating point: whether u=0.65 equilibrates inside 0.55-0.65 and with what tau, which directly sets feedforward for y=0.6 and controller timing.
experiments.expected_observation: If convex positive-gain with ~8-12s tau and ss(0.65)~0.60-0.70 is right, y will rise monotonically from ~0.575 toward ~0.61-0.63 over 4s with positive but flattening slope ~0.01/s still positive in last seconds and only +/-0.01 noise, not flat or falling.

experiments.uncertainty_targeted: Steady-state u needed to hold y=0.6 and high-side gain/settling: whether u=0.65 equilibrates above band vs u~0.60 holds inside, which sets feedforward and separates linear vs convex extrapolation.
experiments.expected_observation: If convex positive-gain with ~8-12s tau and ss(0.65)~0.68-0.72 is right, y from ~0.616 will hold/rise slowly to ~0.62-0.64 over 3s with small positive slope ~0.005-0.01/s still positive in last seconds and only +/-0.01 noise, not falling or jumping.

experiments.uncertainty_targeted: Steady-state u needed to hold y=0.6 and settling at operating point: continuing same 0.6 separates ss inside-band vs above-band and measures residual slope needed for feedforward.
experiments.expected_observation: If convex positive-gain with ~8-12s tau and ss(0.6)~0.68-0.75 is right, y will hold/rise slowly from ~0.637 toward ~0.645-0.655 over 3s with small positive slope ~0.004-0.008/s still positive in last seconds and only +/-0.01 noise, not falling or jumping.

experiments.uncertainty_targeted: Steady-state u needed to hold y=0.6 and high-side gain: whether stepping down to 0.5 reverses the positive slope at 0.648 brackets ss inside vs above band and sets feedforward.
experiments.expected_observation: If convex positive-gain with ss(0.6) above 0.65 and ss(0.5) below 0.65 is right, y from ~0.648 will stop rising and hold/fall slightly to ~0.62-0.64 over 4s with small zero-to-negative slope ~-0.015 to 0.0 in last seconds and only +/-0.01 noise, not continue rising at +0.004/s.

experiments.uncertainty_targeted: Steady-state u needed to hold y=0.6 and settling tau at operating point: continuing same 0.5 hold tests whether 0.64 is equilibrium and measures residual slope needed to set feedforward and controller timing.
experiments.expected_observation: If convex positive-gain with long tau and ss(0.5) near 0.6-0.65 is right, y will continue to hold around 0.63-0.65 from 0.64 with near-zero slope -0.005 to +0.002/s in last seconds and only +/-0.01 noise, not continue rising at +0.004/s as under u=0.6 nor fall fast.

ledger.statement: Increasing constant pump duty u increases steady-state level y (positive static gain).
Step response has lag/time-constant of several seconds (~5-12s); 6-16s holds are not guaranteed to reach full equilibrium near target.
Dead zone at low u is small: u=0.3 produces a clearly positive equilibrium versus u=0.
At u=0 the level decays on its own toward a near-zero equilibrium due to drainage.
Steady-state y is approximately linear in u, and the u needed to hold y=0.6 is in mid-range ~0.4-0.7.
Sensor noise on y is small relative to the 0.10 control band (std < ~0.02).
Response to constant u is stable without sustained oscillation or overshoot.

Static gain increases with u (convex): u=0.3 equilibrates near ~0.07-0.10 while u=0.6 is still rising past 0.653 and u=0.5 holds ~0.64 with near-zero slope, larger than linear extrapolation from low u.
